articles.title: Tinubu: The Mamman Lagos Theory
articles.summary: Late President Muhammadu Buhari had contested Nigeria’s presidential elections three different times: the 2003, 2007 and 2011 elections, and lost in all three. He contested the results from the Court of Appeal to the Supreme Court, but victory eluded his quest for the number one seat in the country at the time. In 2011, he […]
articles.hausa_translation: Tinubu: Ka'idar Mamman Lagos - Jita da aka wallata game da shugaban Buhari da ya yi yunwa gaida gaida kafin ya same gida a 2015, amma wannan labari ya fita gida ne game da Tinubu da yake da alaƙa da Lagos.
critical_questions: Why is the article titled 'Mamman Lagos Theory' and what specific theory is being proposed about Tinubu's connection to Lagos politics?

articles.title: Nigerian Guild Of Editors Demands Immediate Release Of Detained Investigative Journalist Ojukwu
